measured_by: operator-signed-in browser session, read directly from the Keyword Research panel
note: Companion measurement for the seeds listed in WPP-llm/docs/query-coverage/measurement-plan.md (seeds 3, 13, 18 and the Tier C candidates in blue-ocean.md). This file is DELIBERATELY SEPARATE from evidence_queries.json. That file is consumed by scripts/atlas/build_query_atlas.mjs, whose rank_score sorts on the `volume` field, and `volume` there already holds two incompatible units (T1 GSC impressions and T2b Semrush modelled volume). Adding a third unit - Bing impressions - to the same array would deepen that defect. Nothing here is written back into evidence_queries.json without a deliberate unit decision first.
unit: Bing Webmaster Tools impressions for the seed over the stated window. NOT Google impressions and NOT Semrush modelled market volume. Do not compare these figures directly against T1 or T2b numbers.
reading_rule: 'insufficient_data' is what Bing itself returns ('Bing doesn't have enough data to show trend here'). It is a measured absence at Bing's reporting floor, not a measured zero, and not a statement about Google. It is sufficient to REFUSE a build; it is not sufficient to assert that nobody searches the query.

conclusions: Exactly one horselegalguide.com seed returns a measurable Bing figure: `horse bill of sale`, 307 impressions. Every other seed tested is below Bing's reporting floor.

That one measurable query has a SERP in which 10 of 10 results are a downloadable document. It cannot be contested with prose, and this repository publishes prose - 0 of 564 dist pages contain the string 'download' and 0 contain 'notariz' (grepped 2026-08-26).

The Related, Question and Newly-discovered tabs are empty for every equine seed. measurement-plan.md proposed those tabs as the free fan-out and blue-ocean source for this property. They are not a source here. Tier C of blue-ocean.md remains unpriced and, on this evidence, unbuildable.

docs/strategy/publishing-cadence.md requires a measured query before a new page. data/cadence/policy.json sets new_pages_per_week to 0 with the note 'Client repo. Publishing is client-approved only.' Both gates independently say: add nothing.

The correct equine action from this measurement is subtraction and repair on the existing 564 pages, which is client-approved work this repository is currently frozen against, plus the legal review scoped in docs/strategy/equine-document-gap-legal-review.md before any document ships.
